card.name: Start of drug names beginning with M
card.fires_on: The first letter M (or m) that begins a drug or chemical name such as mefenamic acid, mefloquine, mirtazapine, methylene blue or methyl bromide. It also fires on the m of a compound or foreign word.

modes.label: Drug name opening
modes.description: A capital or lowercase M starts a drug name right after a class label, 'of', 'for' or 'or'.

modes.label: Other words with m
modes.description: An m starts or joins a non-drug compound or foreign word.

card.writes: It seems to push up word-start pieces beginning with m, n or s, such as 'sim' and 'nit', and to push down unrelated Chinese pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the lone letter M that begins a drug name like mefenamic acid or mefloquine.
